direction: Retain animated parts/pixel rendering; match the existing painted portraits in identity, anatomy, materials and equipment.
scope: All 53 bestiary entries and all six classes, including ten named champions and class-specific shade gear.

monsters.rat: Brown coarse fur, round ears, long bare tail and whiskered muzzle.
monsters.bat: Brown bat with warm leathery wings, oversized ears and visible fangs.
monsters.slime: Faceless green gel mound, glossy lobes, bubbles and airborne droplets.
monsters.spider: Dark violet cave spider with clustered red eyes, long legs and red abdomen marking.
monsters.goblin: Green pointed-eared goblin in worn leather, carrying a knife.
monsters.skeleton: Bone soldier in a rusty helmet, sword and wooden shield.
monsters.zombie: Pale decaying humanoid in ragged clothes, reaching forward.
monsters.orc: Green tusked warrior in worn armour with a heavy axe.
monsters.ghoul: Gaunt pale humanoid, long clawed hands and needle teeth; no goblin ears.
monsters.wraith: Purple tattered hood around a visible spectral skull and cold eyes.
monsters.ogre: Heavy, broad, bare-chested ogre carrying a thick wooden club.
monsters.troll: Green moss-haired troll with long arms, hooked nose and claws.
monsters.minotaur: Brown bull-headed warrior with swept horns, nose ring and double axe.
monsters.kobold: Rust-red reptilian scavenger with tail, leather and spear.
monsters.archer: Goblin bowman with leather hood, quiver, bow and a connected string.
monsters.basilisk: Low, brown stony-scaled reptile with amber eyes and a spined back.
monsters.rustmaw: Rust-brown armoured beetle, enormous mandibles and feathered antennae.
monsters.acolyte: Gaunt human caster in a black hood, violet magic and bone-topped staff.
monsters.moth: Pale golden cave moth with patterned wings and feathered antennae.
monsters.thornhog: Small brown boar with short legs and a mantle of quills.
monsters.imp: Red-brown horned imp with leathery wings, pointed ears and tail.
monsters.cutpurse: Hooded goblin thief in dark leather, knife and stolen purse.
monsters.lookout: Goblin sentry with rough shoulder cape and bone whistle; no large banner.
monsters.hexer: Goblin witch in dark violet cloth, skull cap and bone-charm staff.
monsters.pikeman: Goblin infantry with dented iron helmet, quilted coat and long pike.
monsters.hound: Lean charcoal hound, canine muzzle and ears, violet eyes and blink wisps.
monsters.quillback: Brown bear-like quilled beast with rounded ears, dark muzzle and paws; no boar tusks.
monsters.wyrm: Wingless rust-red drake with heavy body, long reptilian jaw and curled horns.
monsters.drowned: Waterlogged humanoid corpse with weeds and dripping ragged cloth.
monsters.eyeless: Pale long-limbed hunter with smooth blind head, needle teeth and claws; no ears or eye sockets.
monsters.drow_warrior: Ash-grey elf with white hair, black armour and two held curved blades.
monsters.drow_mage: Ash-grey white-haired elf in violet robes with violet fire.
monsters.grey_dwarf: Broad grey dwarf with dark braided beard, copper fittings and a block-headed hammer.
monsters.dwarf_arbalest: Grey dwarf with dark beard, iron helmet and large crossbow.
monsters.lizardfolk: Green reptilian warrior, orange crest, spear, turtle-shell shield and heavy tail.
monsters.lizard_shaman: Green reptilian shaman with orange crest, reed cloak, bone charms and staff.
monsters.emberling: Small black basalt creature with orange fissures and furnace glow.
monsters.mimic: Toothed wooden chest with metal bands and tongue; barrel disguises remain a valid gameplay variant.
monsters.puffcap: Pale rounded fungus with scabbed skin, gills, stubby roots and spores; no skull face.
monsters.lich: Undead skull in a dark hood, gold crown and dark robes; cold spell light remains unchanged.
monsters.heartforged: Dark iron furnace guardian with glowing chest and heavy hammer.
monsters.warlord: Olive goblin king with hammered-gold crown, dark leather, fur, red cloak and war drum.
monsters.shade: Cold blue armoured fallen knight with sword and shield; class gear remains a deliberate variant.
monsters.grisk: Goblin king with bucket-and-spoon crown and ragged red cloak.
monsters.vessra: Elder spider queen with pale abdomen marking and hanging silk.
monsters.ushgar: Orc chief with horned iron helmet, red face paint, fur and skull ornaments.
monsters.morrow: Yellow-grey elder ghoul with belly, finger-bone crown and thighbone in its jaws.
monsters.orla: Grey-clad spectral abbess with white wimple, empty face, prayer beads and cracked halo.
monsters.gorrum: Old grey-green troll with long white moss beard and skull necklace.
monsters.skarrow: Ash-brown elder wyrm with third horn, facial scar, clouded eye and hoard.
monsters.vaelith: Ash-skinned elf priestess with white hair, silver spider crown and black/wine-red robes.
monsters.hissra: Dark green elder lizard with white crest, tooth collar and reed mantle.
monsters.durgrim: Grey dwarf thane with white copper-bound beard, iron crown, scorched red cloak and smith hammer.

heroes.fighter: Weathered fair-skinned man, short brown beard, nasal helmet, mail and dark red surcoat.
heroes.cleric: Brown-skinned woman with cropped dark hair, cream vestments, brass fittings and mace.
heroes.mage: Older brown-skinned man with close grey hair and beard, navy cloak and amber-tipped staff; no circlet.
heroes.thief: Fair-skinned dark-haired woman in dark hood and leather, visible mouth and shoulder sword; no mask.
heroes.ranger: Fair-skinned man with loose auburn hair, short beard, olive-brown cloak, bow and quiver; no braids.
heroes.druid: Warm-skinned woman with loose curly brown hair, moss-green leaf mantle and natural ornaments; no antlers or beard.
heroes.spellblade: The Wayfarer: weathered male face, brown beard and long hair, charcoal hood and light armour, pale blue runes, sword in right hand and silver lantern in left.
